check_findings.meaning: Read-only display of existing check judgments. Decisive includes support or refutation, not source agreement or task completion. Internal checks do not add original units; no declared checks does not mean complete. Conditions and review qualifications remain in the evidence.

note: Native task and object judgments are projected without promotion. concluded applies to the declared scope; numerical support is not a formal proof or whole-paper certificate.
